package converted

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"errors"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"golang.org/x/net/html"
)

type failWriter struct{ err error }

func (w failWriter) Write([]byte) (int, error) { return 0, w.err }

func good() EmailField {
	return EmailField{ID: "contact-email", Name: "contact_email", Label: "Contact email", Value: "not-an-email", Placeholder: "person@example.test"}
}

func render(t *testing.T, data EmailField) string {
	t.Helper()
	c, err := NewEmailField(data)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var b bytes.Buffer
	if err := c.Render(context.Background(), &b); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return b.String()
}

func walk(n *html.Node, fn func(*html.Node)) {
	fn(n)
	for child := n.FirstChild; child != nil; child = child.NextSibling {
		walk(child, fn)
	}
}

func attr(n *html.Node, key string) (string, bool) {
	for _, a := range n.Attr {
		if a.Key == key {
			return a.Val, true
		}
	}
	return "", false
}

func nodes(t *testing.T, markup string) (*html.Node, *html.Node, *html.Node, int) {
	t.Helper()
	doc, err := html.Parse(strings.NewReader(markup))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var input, description *html.Node
	icons := 0
	walk(doc, func(n *html.Node) {
		if n.Type != html.ElementNode {
			return
		}
		switch n.Data {
		case "input":
			if input != nil {
				t.Fatal("multiple inputs rendered")
			}
			input = n
		case "p":
			description = n
		case "svg":
			icons++
		case "script", "img", "button", "form":
			t.Fatalf("injected or invented element %s", n.Data)
		}
	})
	if input == nil {
		t.Fatal("input missing")
	}
	return doc, input, description, icons
}

func TestRuntimeSourceDefaultParsedDOMParity(t *testing.T) {
	data := EmailField{ID: "fixture-email", Name: "fixture_email", Label: "Fixture mailbox", Value: "retained@example.test", Placeholder: "person@example.test", Error: "Synthetic rejection."}
	actual := render(t, data)
	got, err1 := html.Parse(strings.NewReader(actual))
	want, err2 := html.Parse(strings.NewReader(sourceExpected))
	if err1 != nil || err2 != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {
		t.Fatalf("synthetic source DOM mismatch: got=%q want=%q", actual, sourceExpected)
	}
}

func TestRuntimeErrorAndCleanStates(t *testing.T) {
	errorTokens := []string{"text-red-900", "outline-red-300", "placeholder:text-red-300", "focus:outline-red-600", "dark:text-red-400", "dark:outline-red-500/50", "dark:placeholder:text-red-400/70", "dark:focus:outline-red-400"}
	neutralTokens := []string{"text-gray-900", "outline-gray-300", "placeholder:text-gray-400", "focus:outline-indigo-600", "dark:text-white", "dark:outline-white/10", "dark:placeholder:text-gray-500", "dark:focus:outline-indigo-500"}

	d := good()
	d.Error = "Use a permitted synthetic address."
	_, input, description, icons := nodes(t, render(t, d))
	class, _ := attr(input, "class")
	for _, token := range errorTokens {
		if !strings.Contains(" "+class+" ", " "+token+" ") {
			t.Fatalf("error palette token missing: %s", token)
		}
	}
	if invalid, ok := attr(input, "aria-invalid"); !ok || invalid != "true" {
		t.Fatal("invalid state not exposed")
	}
	if described, ok := attr(input, "aria-describedby"); !ok || described != d.ID+"-error" {
		t.Fatal("error description not linked")
	}
	if description == nil || icons != 1 {
		t.Fatal("error description or icon missing")
	}
	if id, _ := attr(description, "id"); id != d.ID+"-error" || description.FirstChild == nil || description.FirstChild.Data != d.Error {
		t.Fatal("incorrect error description")
	}

	d.Error = ""
	_, input, description, icons = nodes(t, render(t, d))
	class, _ = attr(input, "class")
	for _, token := range neutralTokens {
		if !strings.Contains(" "+class+" ", " "+token+" ") {
			t.Fatalf("neutral palette token missing: %s", token)
		}
	}
	if _, ok := attr(input, "aria-invalid"); ok {
		t.Fatal("clean field retained aria-invalid")
	}
	if _, ok := attr(input, "aria-describedby"); ok || description != nil || icons != 0 {
		t.Fatal("clean field retained error UI")
	}
}

func TestRuntimeSafeBindingsOptionalFlagsAndNonEmailRetention(t *testing.T) {
	d := good()
	d.Label = `<script>label</script> & text`
	d.Value = `not-an-email"><img src=x>`
	d.Placeholder = `<b>placeholder</b>`
	d.Error = `<img src=x> rejection`
	d.Required, d.Autofocus = true, true
	out := render(t, d)
	doc, input, description, icons := nodes(t, out)
	if value, _ := attr(input, "value"); value != d.Value {
		t.Fatal("non-email value not retained exactly")
	}
	if placeholder, _ := attr(input, "placeholder"); placeholder != d.Placeholder {
		t.Fatal("placeholder binding changed")
	}
	if _, ok := attr(input, "required"); !ok {
		t.Fatal("required flag omitted")
	}
	if _, ok := attr(input, "autofocus"); !ok {
		t.Fatal("autofocus flag omitted")
	}
	text := ""
	walk(doc, func(n *html.Node) {
		if n.Type == html.TextNode {
			text += n.Data
		}
	})
	if !strings.Contains(text, d.Label) || description == nil || !strings.Contains(text, d.Error) || icons != 1 {
		t.Fatal("safe text bindings changed")
	}

	d = good()
	_, input, _, _ = nodes(t, render(t, d))
	if _, ok := attr(input, "required"); ok {
		t.Fatal("default required flag emitted")
	}
	if _, ok := attr(input, "autofocus"); ok {
		t.Fatal("default autofocus flag emitted")
	}
}

func TestRuntimePresentationBoundsAndIdentifiers(t *testing.T) {
	for _, field := range []string{"ID", "Name"} {
		for _, bad := range []string{"", "1leading", "bad space", "bad/slash", "bad:colon", strings.Repeat("a", 65), string([]byte{255})} {
			d := good()
			reflect.ValueOf(&d).Elem().FieldByName(field).SetString(bad)
			if c, err := NewEmailField(d); err == nil || c != nil {
				t.Fatalf("accepted %s=%q", field, bad)
			}
		}
	}
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		field string
		bad   []string
	}{
		{"Label", []string{"", "   ", "bad\ncontrol", string([]byte{255}), strings.Repeat("x", 201)}},
		{"Value", []string{"bad\x00control", string([]byte{255}), strings.Repeat("x", 4097)}},
		{"Placeholder", []string{"bad\tcontrol", string([]byte{255}), strings.Repeat("x", 321)}},
		{"Error", []string{"   ", "bad\rcontrol", string([]byte{255}), strings.Repeat("x", 1001)}},
	} {
		for _, bad := range tc.bad {
			d := good()
			reflect.ValueOf(&d).Elem().FieldByName(tc.field).SetString(bad)
			if c, err := NewEmailField(d); err == nil || c != nil {
				t.Fatalf("accepted %s=%q", tc.field, bad)
			}
		}
	}
	for _, value := range []string{"", "not-an-email", "blocked@example.test", strings.Repeat("x", 4096)} {
		d := good()
		d.Value = value
		render(t, d)
	}
}

func TestRuntimeWriterFailureAndCancellation(t *testing.T) {
	d := good()
	c, err := NewEmailField(d)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	sentinel := errors.New("writer failure")
	if err := c.Render(context.Background(), failWriter{sentinel}); !errors.Is(err, sentinel) {
		t.Fatal("writer error lost")
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	cancel()
	if err := c.Render(ctx, &bytes.Buffer{}); !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
		t.Fatal("cancellation lost")
	}
}
